_note: Chosen size: P68 held at 68 m LOA, 62 m waterline, 13.0 m beam (owner direction). Supersedes the 66 m final. Not yet applied to layout/decks-layout.json, whose outlines remain at 68 m and 12.1 m beam until regenerated.

derivation.loa: Smallest LOA at which every room corner (192 corners in layout/decks-layout.json) lies inside the ellipse outline at beam 12.1 m. Found by search: 64.0 m.
derivation.beam: Kept at 12.1 m. Rooms need at least about 5 m half-beam (max |y| = 5.0 m), so the rooms alone do not set the beam. Beam for stability and ballast is not derived here.
derivation.lwl: Recorded waterline-to-LOA ratio 62/68 = 0.912, so LWL = 58.4 m.

buoyancy_check.block_coefficient_status: Midpoint of the placeholder range 0.30 to 0.45

open: Outlines for every deck must be regenerated at 64 m, then the layout validator and access validator re-run.
The keel-up target of 4.8 m needs about 1,304 t displacement at this hull; the reference is 806 t. The weight register must reach about 1,300 t, or the draft targets change.
The minimum LOA has no margin. The ellipse outline is idealised, so a real hull needs margin at the bow and stern.
